title: Sakaler Sure
desc: Talented singers and artists perform some of the most popular devotional and folk songs of Bengali music and enthral the audience with their performance.

title: Bijoya
desc: An emergency forces Padma to move to Kolkata with her husband, Ganesh. However, things change after she crosses paths with Nasir Ali.

title: Sathihara
desc: Musicians Anuradha and Jeet fall in love and marry, but their relationship is tested when Anuradha's thriving career begins to overshadow Jeet's ambitions.

title: Satarupa
desc: Dr. Rupa unintentionally causes Shatadal's memory loss, leading him to see her as his only kin. Later, they fall for each other but when his past returns, he forgets her.

title: Shapath Nilam
desc: Sukanta is shattered when his wife, Minu, is raped on their honeymoon. Though his wife fails to recognise him after the incident, her twin sister, Debu, tries to find the culprit.

title: Projapati
desc: A 65-year-old retired widower, living alone with his son Joy, hopes he will marry to ease his loneliness. However, Joy, a busy wedding planner, has no plans to settle down anytime soon.
